## Int8 CNN and log-mel on the Pico 2 (on-device bench)

Model `phase4_idcnn_int8`, fan, seed 0, built into `andon_bench.uf2`. Errors are against the Python reference on the exported test vectors. Times from the Pico's microsecond timer.

| Run | Clock (MHz) | Log-mel ms/frame | CNN ms/patch | CNN ms/frame | Total ms per 32 ms frame | Worst log-mel err (dB) | Int8 input diffs | Worst score err | Static RAM (B) | Self-test |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 3 | 150 | 1.456 | 299.79 | 9.368 | 10.824 | 1.53e-05 | 0 of 24576 | 2.48e-07 | 196624 | PASS |
| 4 | 150 | 1.456 | 299.79 | 9.369 | 10.825 | 1.53e-05 | 0 of 24576 | 2.48e-07 | 196624 | PASS |
| mean of 2 | | 1.456 | 299.79 | 9.369 | 10.825 | | | | | |

Measured: 10.82 ms of compute per 32 ms frame on one core, under the 20 ms budget. Phase 4 estimate (`results/phase4_mcu.md`): 3.27 ms per frame and 98.32 ms per CNN score; measured 299.79 ms per score, 3.0 times the estimate.

## Per-fan GMM on the Pico 2 (on-device bench)

Model: h3_gmm, trained on d1+d2, seed 0; vectors from d1/normal_id_00_00000000.wav, d1/normal_id_01_00000000.wav, d1/normal_id_02_00000000.wav (float32, as `andon.export_gmm` writes it, read from the board's log). Each fan's test audio is streamed through the C log-mel and the window mean, and every window is scored by all three fans' GMMs. Errors are against Python (scikit-learn) on the exported test vectors.

| Run | Clock (MHz) | Log-mel ms/frame | GMM ms/score | GMM ms/frame | Total ms per 32 ms frame | Worst log-mel err, fan audio (dB) | Worst window-mean err (dB) | Worst score err (relative), from Python's means | Worst score err (relative), end to end | Static RAM (B) | Self-test |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 3 | 150 | 1.456 | 7.301 | 0.228 | 1.684 | 1.53e-05 | 1.14e-05 | 1.94e-06 | 2.51e-06 | 196624 | PASS |
| 4 | 150 | 1.456 | 7.300 | 0.228 | 1.684 | 1.53e-05 | 1.14e-05 | 1.94e-06 | 2.51e-06 | 196624 | PASS |
| mean of 2 | | 1.456 | 7.300 | 0.228 | 1.684 | | | | | | |

Every run's self-test passed: the C scores match Python within the tolerances. Measured: 1.684 ms of compute per 32 ms frame on one core (the log-mel of every frame, plus one fan's GMM score for each window), under the 20 ms budget. Each run scores 27 windows (384 frames of fan audio); slowest score 7.322 ms.
